claimed_purpose.text: Aelios is scoped to three functions: store, on-demand recall, and nightly secretary. Daytime intelligence is delegated to agents and client system prompts.
Aelios acts as a gateway that sanitizes requests, manages session identity, records raw requests, and injects memory into the current turn.
Gateway layer that injects recalled memory into the request payload sent to an upstream LLM, on human turns only.
MCP server named 'companion-memory-mcp' exposing memory tools for a companion agent
Aelios uses a dream / daily digest path as an automatic long-term memory mechanism
Cold-start boot package delivered once per session for stable, cached context

mechanisms.text: Write path splits by trust source: agent writes via MCP/REST go directly to the database (upsert); dream nightly extraction output goes entirely into a candidates review queue and never directly to the store, regardless of confidence.

The drop_block mode instructs upstream to discard mismatched thinking blocks and affected subsequent blocks; it sacrifices some reasoning continuity and prior mismatched history is not restored if the user switches back.

The lifecycle table tracks supersession chains (`supersedes_id`, `superseded_by_id`) and a `fact_key`, supporting conflict/supersession modeling, though population of these fields is not shown in this file.
Model-level memory gate: only the registered primary model for an assistant gets memory recording and recall; unregistered models (e.g. small helper models) pass through without being remembered.
Recall (memory_recall) queries glossary + active memories + world_fact + longtail but does NOT query precious (precious lives in boot) and does NOT apply the 2-item auto-injection budget
Message log (ingest) is stored separately from curated memory: messages are saved to a conversations/messages table via saveIngestMessages; memory extraction is a separate optional step
Multiple named memory kinds are distinguished: 'authored' (from remember_now or a human author), 'distilled' (from dream, judge, or extract pipelines), and the raw type otherwise.
When a tool_result is followed by independent user text, recall fires on the new user input and memory is appended after the result and user text, not inserted before the result.
Messages are stored in D1 using INSERT OR IGNORE with a partial unique index for deduplication; idempotency is achieved via a time-bucketed hash on the user-message write path.
Write path (automated): nightly cron job extracts facts from that day's conversations and puts candidates into a review queue; also writes diary, weekly, and monthly entries.
Write operations (create, delete) are eventually consistent; newly created records may not be immediately visible via get, and deleted records may persist for a few seconds.
Forget/delete: memories can be deleted via the admin panel or via the memory_delete MCP tool; expired memories are flagged at 180 days and hard-deleted 30 days later.
Memory candidates are a review queue; they can be approved (creating or superseding a memory), discarded, merged into an existing memory, or explicitly superseded.
Human utterances are persisted (and optionally indexed for remember) before recall runs; a rememberStatus tracks whether the write was saved, indexed, or failed.
Human-in-the-loop review: nightly-extracted candidate memories appear in an audit queue; the user approves or discards them before they become long-term memory.
Natural-language queries use vector similarity search against stored content; retrieval is controlled by MEMORY_MIN_SCORE and MEMORY_FILTER_MIN_SCORE thresholds
Isolation: memory is per-assistant; each assistant has its own write space and can optionally read from additional spaces (e.g. a legacy or shared namespace).
Two storage backends: v1 uses Vectorize (vector store only); v2 uses D1 (primary/canonical) plus Vectorize (mirror), gated by MEMORY_LIFECYCLE_ENABLED
Delete is a soft delete: the DB row is soft-deleted and its embedding is removed from the vector store; a legacy vector-only path is also handled.
Memory entries already carry a source_message_ids field for traceability; the proposal is that dream output should also attach this field
Forget/delete: messages expire ~7 days; expired memories marked at 180 days; invalidated records hard-deleted 30 days after that
Memories carry an E-axis protection flag and an authored_by field distinguishing hand-authored entries from automated ones.
Nightly dream pipeline handles extraction; memory_extract_dryrun is deprecated in v3 in favour of dream dry_run endpoints
Vector memory upsert path exists but has no durable retry; failures are logged and execution continues.
Soft-archive (status='archived') is a non-destructive forget that does not touch the supersede chain
response_tendency is a per-memory instruction on how the model should act when that memory fires
digest_get and digest_set are deprecated in v3; digest now lives in the client system prompt
Superseded versions are hidden from recall by default; include_history flag exposes them
Glossary is L5 literal recall, not in the vector index, upserted by (namespace, term)
Auto-injection is a separate short patch distinct from explicit recall tools
The store backend is SQLite, used in the actual Worker path under test.
Hard delete in v2 removes from both D1 and Vectorize simultaneously

ledger.claim: Diary entries (daily_log / weekly_log) are impressions, not verified facts; daily entries roll up to weekly_log
ledger.quote: These are impressions, not verified facts. Omit date for today+yesterday (recent). Use week (e.g. 2026-W29) for weekly_log. Rolled-up daily dates fall back to weekly_log. Fetch explicitly when needed; do not treat diary as ground truth.

ledger.claim: Memories are persisted per namespace in a D1 database with type, content, importance, confidence, tags, source, and optional expiry fields.
ledger.quote: const created = await createMemory(env.DB, { namespace: resolveNamespace(profile, body.namespace), type, content, summary: readOptionalString(body.summary), importance: readNumber(body.importance, 0.5), confidence: readNumber(body.confidence, 0.8), pinned: readBoolean(body.pinned), tags: readStringArray(body.tags), source: readOptionalString(body.source) || profile.source, sourceMessageIds: readStringArray(body.source_message_ids), expiresAt: readOptionalString(body.expires_at) });
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: v2 write path uses fact-keyed upsert, enabling idempotent create-or-update by semantic key rather than by row ID.
ledger.quote: const result = await upsertMemoryByFactKey(env, { namespace, factKey, type, content, importance: readNumber(body.importance, 0.6), confidence: readNumber(body.confidence, 0.8), ... });
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Delete is soft: the DB row is soft-deleted and its vector embedding is removed; a legacy vector-only delete path is also handled.
ledger.quote: const deleted = await softDeleteMemory(env.DB, { namespace: profile.namespace, id }); if (deleted) await deleteMemoryEmbeddingBestEffort(env, deleted);
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Conflict resolution uses supersession: conflicting active memories are replaced by a new record; the old record is retained with superseded status.
ledger.quote: const result = await supersedeMemory(env, { namespace, oldId: hit.memory.id, newContent: input.content, newType: input.type, newFactKey: null, importance: input.importance, confidence: input.confidence, tags, source: input.source, sourceMessageIds: input.sourceMessageIds, reason: "dedup_gate_supersede" });
ledger.label: measured

// #35: 周块与 data 平行下发，不混进 data —— 它是上下文块，不是命中。

ledger.claim: Write path is bifurcated by trust: agent/MCP writes land directly in the database; dream extraction output is always queued for human review in candidates before any fact reaches the memory store.
ledger.quote: 写入按信任来源分流：agent 经 MCP/REST 直写（upsert）→ 直接落库；dream 夜间抽取产物 → 全部进 candidates 审核队列，一条都不直接落库 ，无论置信度。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Supersede/conflict resolution for world facts exists and is handled inside the dream pipeline; merge/update/delete suggestions route through the candidates review queue.
ledger.quote:
dream 保留：daily_log 生成（title+summary 写 daily_log 表）、world_fact supersede、重要原文摘录。
merge/update/delete 建议同样只落 candidates（用现有 merge/supersede 审核动作承接）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Retrieval is not always-inject: daily_log / diary content is explicitly never auto-injected; proxy-mode auto-injection applies only to recalled memories with k=3, min_score=0.15.
ledger.quote:
日记（daily_log）升格为一等公民端点，agent 自己 fetch， 永不自动注入 。
代理模式自动注入保留，默认 k=3、 min_score=0.15 。
ledger.locator: 设计裁定 / bullet 4; Phase B · B1
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: L1 digest (a curated summary layer) is fully removed from store, REST, and MCP. Existing digest rows in D1 are orphaned but not deleted.
ledger.quote:
L1 digest 全线移除，persona 归客户端管理。
D1 里已有的 digest 数据不迁移不删除，表结构不动（只是没人读写了）。
ledger.locator: 设计裁定 / bullet 3; Phase B · B2
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Per-turn compression at recall time is removed; the reranker is retained. Recall returns raw memory text after dedup and score-floor filtering.
ledger.quote:
src/memory/filter.ts ：删 per-turn 压缩模型调用（MEMORY_FILTER_MODEL 相关全部代码路径）；reranker（ MEMORY_RERANKER_MODEL / ENABLE_MEMORY_RERANKER ）原样保留。
召回产物改为记忆原文直出（去重、分数地板照旧）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Nightly dream extraction runs once at 20:10; the previous 4-hour extraction cron is deleted. Dream is the only automated fact-extraction path.
ledger.quote: wrangler.toml ：crons 删 "0 */4 * * *" ，保留 dream 的 "10 20 * * *" 。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Aelios exposes a REST API served by a Worker, authenticated with an API key; the hook calls only that API and requires no LLM provider keys.
ledger.quote: COMPANION_MEMORY_API_KEY is the Aelios Worker API key, usually the same value as CHATBOX_API_KEY . It is only used to call your Aelios REST API. This hook does not need any model-provider or LLM API keys.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Write path buffers messages locally before uploading to Aelios in batches; deduplication state is also stored locally to prevent re-ingesting the same messages.
ledger.quote: Local buffer, lock, dedupe state, and audit log directory.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The page describes retrieve-then-inject scaffolding only; there is no description of how Aelios selects, summarises, or consolidates memories on the server side.
ledger.quote: searches long-term memory and injects relevant context
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Vector embedding quality is tightly coupled to the shape of the content field; wrapping quotes with metadata labels causes retrieval failure even when the vector was successfully written
ledger.quote: Exact content search can find the record, which indicates the vector was written. Natural-language search cannot find it, which points to poor embedding text shape rather than a storage failure.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Create and delete operations on the memory store are eventually consistent, not immediately consistent.
ledger.quote: Create has a short consistency delay before get can see the new record, and delete also appears eventually consistent after a few seconds
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Dream/daily digest is the automatic long-term memory write path; a failure in this path means memories exist in the store but are not naturally retrievable — effectively lost
ledger.quote: For deployments that rely on dream / daily digest as an automatic long-term memory path, a memory that exists but is not naturally retrievable behaves like a lost memory.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Lowering vector score thresholds (MEMORY_MIN_SCORE, MEMORY_FILTER_MIN_SCORE) to 0.1 did not recover natural-language retrieval of poorly shaped dream excerpts
ledger.quote: After lowering `MEMORY_MIN_SCORE=0.1` and `MEMORY_FILTER_MIN_SCORE=0.1`, the same natural-language query still produced `raw_count=0`.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: E-axis flag and authored_by field gate hand-authored memory protection, blocking automated overwrites.
ledger.quote: 候选的目标记忆是 hand-authored（E-axis 标记，`authored_by` 非空）
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Conflict between automated candidate and hand-authored memory is a known continuity-integrity scenario requiring human supersede rather than auto-approval.
ledger.quote: 该记忆为手写，需人工改用 supersede
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Dream candidates are derived from chat material (聊天原料), establishing a log-to-memory extraction write path.
ledger.quote: dream 从聊天原料产出一条指向它的 `dream_update` 候选
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The system runs as a self-hosted fork (fork kagamiurayama/Aelios) deployed on Cloudflare Workers, confirmed in live operation on 2026-08-15.
ledger.quote: 自部署实例（fork kagamiurayama/Aelios），Worker `ashuo-companion-memory-proxy`，2026-08-15 实跑触发
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Dream distillation (daily summary) fabricated a specific event — user complained about something after work — that did not exist in any of the 33 direct messages or ~200 group messages that day
ledger.quote: agent 把这句当事实复读给用户，用户表示毫无印象，并检索了两人的全部历史对话——没有这条内容
ledger.locator: issue body, 现象 / 核实过程 sections
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The hallucinated content had realistic texture — agent could not self-verify and user could not detect it without manually checking every raw message
ledger.quote:
agent 很难自查（内容读起来完全像真的）
用户也难察觉（这次是「我完全没印象」+ 逐条翻原始记录才抓到）
ledger.locator: issue body, 为什么这个问题值得单列 section
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Memory entries already have a source_message_ids field; the same traceability should be added to dream diary entries
ledger.quote: dream 产物挂上 source_message_ids（memory 条目已有这个字段），让日记逐句可溯源
ledger.label: inferred
